shared_elements: carved stone surface with rounded/arched upper contour
human or anthropomorphic figures rendered in low relief
horizontal dividing bands/lines across the surface
justification: Both are stone monuments with an arched top bearing relief human imagery, a disc-like circular element and horizontal banding, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a massive volumetric monolith dominated by one frontal figure carved in bold, deep, weathered relief, whereas B is a thin flat slab with a shallow, fine, linear incision of many small figures arranged in two stacked registers — utterly different in scale, technique and compositional logic.
